q: Changes in balances and pattern of consumption due to integration of ____ are to be considered in balance assessment.

options.B: kept in the stock adjustment account

q: The figures relating to stores for specific works identified ab initio should ____ in the Stores Budget statement on this account.

options.D: as soon as they are carried out in the works programmes finally submitted to the Railway Board

q: Estimates under 'Issue to Capital - Manufacture Suspense' are initially prepared by the ____ in consultation with the respective Accounts Officers.

options.A: department entrusted with manufacture and repair operations

For Issues to Revenue, the fairly accurate guide used is the ____ after allowing for special items peculiar to each year.

options.B: throw forward from the previous year
options.C: average consumption of the last three years
options.D: consumption of the last year only

q: Estimates of Issues to Revenue are prepared by the ____.

options.A: sold as scrap in the previous year
options.B: indents for which were certified against previous years' grants but which have not been paid before the close of the previous year
options.C: purchased in the previous year but not consumed
options.D: returned from works during the previous year

q: In estimating the Purchase Grant, from the throw forward from previous year and indents of the current year is deducted the ____.

options.C: estimated throw forward to the next year

q: 'Estimated throw forward to the next year' in the Purchase Grant computation means the value of stores ____.

options.A: received from manufacture during the year
options.C: certified and paid during the current year
options.D: indents of which have not been certified against the current year and which are not likely to be paid before the close of the year

q: Receipts from Manufacture into Stores should agree with the credit in the Manufacture Suspense Budget against ____.

options.B: stores department and the various manufacturing departments

q: 'Material returned from Works' in the receipts is a ____ of the estimates submitted by departments.

options.C: the value of fabricated materials likely to be received during the year based on estimates furnished by the departments

options.A: difference between the total debits and total credits during the year
options.D: total of debits during the year

options.C: the total of the debits during the year
options.D: the total of the credits during the year
